Target company: Microsoft (MSFT). Microsoft develops software and cloud services including Windows, Microsoft 365 and Azure, and operates gaming, business-software and related technology businesses.

Focal announcement: Leading in the era of AI: How Microsoft’s platform differentiation and Copilot empowerment are driving AI Transformation.

Decision cutoff: 2024-04-24T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Leading in the era of AI: How Microsoft’s platform differentiation and Copilot empowerment are driving AI Transformation. Published date: 2024-04-24. URL: https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2024/04/24/leading-in-the-era-of-ai-how-microsofts-platform-differentiation-and-copilot-empowerment-are-driving-ai-transformation.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: A Copilot on every desk, every device and across every role is core to Microsoft’s mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We are also building on our relationship with Cloud Software Group to bring joint cloud solutions and generative AI capabilities to more than 100 million people. Companies like Amadeus , AAMI , TotalEnergies and Cushman & Wakefield are leveraging Copilot for Microsoft 365 to enrich customer interactions and advance high-priority projects. Using Power Platform and Microsoft Copilot Studio, Cineplex is saving employees over 30,000 hours annually in manual processing times and reducing ticket refund handling time from 15 minutes to under a minute. Using several AI models, Australian retailer Coles developed an edge computing platform that makes 1.6 billion informed predictions each day so customers can find exactly what they are looking for across its 850 stores.

Historical limitation: the exact historical article version is unverified; publication date does not establish that today's text existed then.

Pre-announcement expectations: No point-in-time analyst consensus or market-implied expectation is available.

Company financial baselines: none supplied.

Incremental financial magnitude inputs: not supplied.

A previously fitted, training-only market model supplied these reference probabilities: up 62.8612%; flat 14.6085%; down 22.5303%. They are predictions, not facts about what happened later.

Prediction target: buy at the first regular-session opening price after the cutoff; compare with the fifth regular-session closing price, counting entry as session one. Predict raw price return. Up means above +1.00%; flat means -1.00% through +1.00% inclusive; down means below -1.00%. The initial pre-entry price reaction is outside the target.

Do not infer analyst consensus, corporate cash spending, incremental sales, or a news-attributed price reaction when it is not supplied.
